company.shortDescription: 37xDubai is a Web3-focused digital art gallery, event venue, and members club company.
company.description:
37xDubai is a Web3-focused digital art gallery, event venue, and members club based in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), United Arab Emirates. The platform aims to bring together artists, collectors, investors, and technology innovators by combining art, blockchain technology, and immersive digital experiences.

Founded in 2022 and backed by the investment firm Morningstar Ventures, 37xDubai was created as an interactive gallery showcasing digital art, NFTs, and technology-driven exhibitions. The space features curated exhibitions, immersive installations, and programmable displays that blend traditional art with Web3 technologies such as blockchain and NFTs.
